arabic text: ROTI RAHI AALEY PAYGAMBAR\nKARBAL SE LE KAR SHAM TAK
english translation text: THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET (A.S.) KEPT CRYING\nALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM

arabic text: ROTI RAHI AALEY PAYGAMBAR KARBAL SE LE KAR SHAM TAK KAT\nTA HI RAHA ZAHRA KA JIGAR KARBAL SE LEKAR SHAM TAK
english translation text: THE FAMILY OF THE PROPHET (A.S.) KEPT CRYING ALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM\nZAHRA’S (S.A.) HEART KEPT BEING HURT ALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM

arabic text:
JAB BAAP KA SEENA CHUTA TO
ZINDA ME BHI JA KAR SO NA SAKI
JEETI RAHI MOT SAI BHI BATTAR
KARBAL SE LEKAR SHAM TAK
english translation text:
WHEN BIBI SAKINA (A.S) LOST HER FATHER
SHE COULDN’T SLEEP EVEN IN THE PRISON OF SHAM
HER LIFE WAS WORSE THAN DEATH
ALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM

arabic text: NA SIR PE RIDA THE ZAINAB KE AUR HAATH BANDHE THE RASSI\nME TEY ROTE KIYA UJRI NE SAFAR KARBAL SE LEKAR SHAM TAK
english translation text: ZAINAB (A.S.) DID NOT HAVE A VEIL TO COVER HERSELF AND HER HANDS WERE TIED IN ROPES\nSHE CRIED ALL THE WAY ALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM

arabic text:
PABAND THI BIBIYAN RASIYON ME
WO KAISAI BACHATA BACHO KO
MASOOM JO MARTE RAHE GIRKAR
KARBAL SE LEKAR SHAM TAK
english translation text:
THE HANDS OF THE LADIES OF THE AHULULBAYT
(A.S) WERE TIED HOW COULD THEY SAVE THE
CHILDREN WHEN THEY WERE FALLING FROM THE CAMELS
ALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM

arabic text:
YEH SOCH KAR FAZAL KE BABA KA
SAR TIKTA NAHI THA NEZE PAR
ZAINAB KO NA DEKHE URYAN
KARBAL SE LEKAR SHAM TAK
english translation text:
THE HEAD OF HAZRAT ABBAS (A.S) WOULD NOT
STAY ON THE SPEAR SO THAT IT
WOULDN’T CATCH SIGHT OF ZAINAB IN THAT STATE
ALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM

arabic text:
SAJJAD BEEMAR KA JURM THA KYA
YEH ZULMO SITAM KYU USPE HWA
PEHNADIA UMMAT NE ZEWAR
KARBAL SE LEKAR SHAM TAK
english translation text:
WHAT WAS IMAM SAJJAD’S (A.S.) CRIME
WHY WAS HE TREATED SO UNJUSTLY
THE UMMAH MADE HIM WEAR HEAVY SHACKLES
ALL THE WAY FROM KARBALA TO SHAM
